messages:
lauren: FYI - nightly perf alert just flagged a regression on small-batch tail latency (~+22% vs baseline) for redwood-lite-13b int8. CI link: https://ci.redwood/bench/23671 :eyeglasses:

mike: copying link. is this across all machines or a specific pool?

lauren: looks concentrated on linux-gpu-ptx-2 pool (5 failures in a row). single-run numbers attached in CI artifacts.

anjali: @lauren can you drop the exact benchmark command/config? i'll kick off a focused repro and start bisect if it's deterministic.

lauren: sure - reproducer is below. it's the nightly small-batch profile (seq 256 -> 1-4 batch sizes).

lauren: ```
./run_bench --model redwood-lite-13b --quant int8 --seq-len 256 --batch-sizes 1,2,4 --iters 100 --pin-cpu 1
```

mike: thanks. i'll try a quick run on my dev box (same kernel) and share traces. if it's only on that pool maybe a kernel/driver bump hit.

ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf job 23671 produced artifacts: cpu-profiles.tar.gz, nvprof-logs.zip, bench-summary.json (attached). See https://ci.redwood/bench/23671/artifacts

dave: quick note - one of the failing hosts had a recent NVIDIA driver update last night. host: gpu-ptx-2-14. can we pin that as suspected? :thinking_face:

anjali: i'll start a git bisect across last 48 hours of merges if we can't repro locally. @mike can you upload the nvprof from your run? flamegraphs are the fastest triage.

mike: uploading now. first glance: more time in attention kernels, but there is also a spike in scheduler syscalls. attaching excerpt: `sched_yield` count up ~3x.

lauren: hmm scheduler noise could be due to host-level cgroup changes or preemption. @sre-bot can you check if cpu-isolation flags or cgroup configs changed for gpu-ptx-2 pool yesterday?

sre-bot: Queried deploy metadata: no config push to cgroups on gpu-ptx-2 between 2366980000 and 2367090000. Kernel patchset landed on 2367058000 (linux-5.15.128) on that pool.

anjali: good catch. can someone run a quick kernel-rolling test? if kernel is the cause we should see repro on any host with that kernel.

mike: ran the bench on a host with linux-5.15.127 (previous). tail latency normal (~baseline). did same on 5.15.128 and saw the +20% tail. consistent so far.

lauren: OK sounds like kernel diff is high-confidence. plan: 1) pin rollout on gpu-ptx-2 back to 5.15.127 for nightly runs, 2) open kernel bug with perf traces, 3) anjali to bisect our runtime changes in parallel to rule out coincident regressions. anyone object?

dave: +1, will queue rollback for nightly pool. i'll coordinate with infra to keep a temporary hold.

anjali: i'll proceed with bisect but update: if kernel repro is consistent i'll deprioritize runtime bisect. starting now, will post results in ~30m. :rocket:

lauren: thanks all. if bisect finds anything i'll reassign. for now @dave please hold the kernel rollback and tag infra. tagging this thread with perf/regression so we capture follow-ups. :thumbsup:
